LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_III.label: lesser umbral reactor
LanguageData.BOR_Reactor_III.description: Produces power by stealing momentum from ubiquitous non-interacting particles - which amounts to 'free energy' in simple, small words.
LanguageData.BOR_Battery_III.label: umbral battery
LanguageData.BOR_Battery_III.description: Stores apocalyptic amounts of electricity for later use. This model has been designed for civilian use, and as such it has no countermeasures to account for rain and fire.
